prompt: With digit1, move tote_1 from the inbound_conveyor to line_feed. The job is done only when tote_1 is on line_feed and channel "line" has sent "RECEIVED": state both as the goal of the job.
why: A message is not an end state of the world, so `message_received` is never allowed in a `goal` (0043 S1), and a goal is what Core receives (`export-goal`). A wait for the message in the plan is a different request: the goal does not hold the message.
